originalTitle: Peter Lynch does not like the AI trade; here's why he says 'Know what you own'
simplifiedContent: Peter Lynch, a well-known investor, is cautious about investing in companies that focus on artificial intelligence (AI). This is because some big tech companies are spending a lot of money on AI and also taking on a lot of debt, which makes some analysts worried. These analysts are questioning whether the money spent on AI will actually lead to good results in the future. As a result, many investors are selling their shares in tech companies, causing their stock prices to drop. This matters because it can help you make informed decisions about your own investments by reminding you to understand what you're investing in, as Lynch advises to "know what you own".

originalTitle: Mind Over Money | Golf taught me the same lesson as investing—stay calm after a bad shot: B Gopkumar
simplifiedContent: B Gopkumar, an experienced investor, is comparing playing golf to investing in the stock market. He says that just like in golf, when you make a bad shot, you should stay calm and not let it affect your next move. Similarly, in investing, if you make a bad decision, you shouldn't let it derail your long-term plan. This matters because it can help you avoid making impulsive decisions based on one mistake, and instead, focus on your overall financial goals. By staying calm and focused, you can make better investment choices and achieve your long-term financial objectives.

originalTitle: Aluminium signals recovery after correction; supply risks and energy concerns may drive the next leg higher
simplifiedContent: The price of aluminum is going back up after a recent drop. This is happening because there's not as much aluminum available as there used to be, and some areas that produce aluminum are worried about having enough energy to keep making it. There are also concerns about getting aluminum from certain parts of the world due to tensions in the Middle East. These factors, combined with strong demand from industries like power and transportation, are likely to drive the price of aluminum even higher. This could be a good sign for investors who own aluminum or companies that produce it.

originalTitle: Q1 results today: Divi's Labs, Muthoot Finance, APL Apollo among over 30 companies set to announce Q1 earnings
simplifiedContent: Today, over 30 companies will share their financial results from the first quarter of the current financial year. This means they will tell us how well they did financially from April to June. originalTitle: Stock market timings change from Monday, August 3: Everything investors and traders need to know
simplifiedContent: On August 3, 2026, India's stock market will have some big changes. A new "Closing Auction Session" will start, which will change how the final prices of some stocks are decided at the end of the day. This will affect the hours when people can buy and sell stocks, as well as which parts of the market are involved. This change might impact how investors and traders make decisions, so it's a good idea for them to understand what's happening. The change is specifically for stocks that involve futures and options contracts, which are types of investments that involve betting on future price movements.
